text:
In the world teetering on the brink of destruction, the chosen one, Kai, was destined to harness the ancient magic to restore balance. While the original tale ended with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world at the cost of his human existence, an alternative ending unfolds differently. Instead of dissolving into the ether, Kai realizes that the ancient magic does not require a vessel to dissipate, but rather a conduit to redirect. He channels the overwhelming energy not into himself, but into the fractured ley lines of the world, acting as a living bridge. The magic flows through him, burning away his physical form but leaving his consciousness intact within the network of the earth. He does not vanish; he becomes the wind in the trees, the warmth in the sun, and the strength in the soil. Kai saves the world not by sacrificing his humanity, but by transcending it, remaining as a silent guardian woven into the very fabric of the restored world, watching over those he saved from afar.

The capital of France is Paris.
